slides.headline: Buying an established investment property just got a lot more expensive.
Negative gearing on established properties is GONE.
slides.body: For new purchases only. Existing investors are fully grandfathered.

slides.supporting_text: No negative gearing. No tax offset. Just out of pocket.

slides.body: Full negative gearing + depreciation still applies.

slides.body: House + granny flat or duplex. Two rental incomes, one loan structure.

slides.supporting_text: On a new build. Before you've paid a single extra dollar out of pocket.
